maturity: Published mixed-signal NAND PIM architecture; public compiler and subarray circuit model, not a fabricated PIM chip or a validated host runtime.

read_depth.paper: Official abstract and author homepage; full MICRO paper not obtained. No claim of reading the original figures or Table II.
read_depth.repository: Top-level and all component READMEs, hardware constants, generic matrix tiling/MVM construction, partitioner/movement insertion, placer, code generation, linearization, load balancing, circuit config/output latency formulas, limited quant-model source.
read_depth.execution: Both builds pass. Original mlp_l5 static code generation passes. Independent fixed-inventory two-expert route probe passes 18 cases. NVSim execution fails before circuit evaluation due to missing generated geometry config.

native_layout.logical_matrix_tile: At most 128 output rows by (128 input columns * 64 stacks); every ConstantMatrixTile is assigned its own virtual MVMU and, with original one-MVMU/core config, its own core.
native_layout.execution: For C input columns, one core receives ceil(C/128) 128-element input chunks up to 64 depths. Existing mvm instruction carries xb_nma, depth, stacks, precision, slideId and isLast. Partial sums across >8192-column matrix tiles use native ALU ADD in the compiler.
native_layout.input_sharing: Core has an independent input register bank. Same logical input tile is sent once per receiving tile and loaded once per receiving core, already in original partitioner; intermediate producer is stored once and sent once per destination tile. Shared-input and distinct-input toy graphs both compile.
native_layout.unverified: No public binary weight programmer or accumulator-reset specification was found. Do not pack several private experts into unused depths of one MVMU merely because the textual instruction has a depth field. No new context or decoder is assumed.

offline_route_trace_result.status: SUPPORTED at original compiler textual-trace level, with fixed full matrix inventory and original row/column/random mapping.
offline_route_trace_result.method: Create all weight matrices in the same order for every route. Build operations only for selected experts. Inactive matrix tiles retain assigned core slots even with zero MVM users.
offline_route_trace_result.toy: Two 512x512 matrices, four output-row tiles per expert, four depths per row tile, eight cores total in compute tile 2. expert0-only uses cores 0..3; expert1-only uses cores 4..7; both preserve those addresses.
offline_route_trace_result.route_compile_is_not_runtime: The experiment proves representability and stable symbolic physical address selection. Host trace upload/dispatch, binary encoding, programmed analog weights, numerical correctness, and native scheduling costs remain unverified.
offline_route_trace_result.no_branch_requirement: Top-K known outside the device permits straight-line per-route traces without device branching. Recompiling each route is an offline audit technique, not a deployable online compiler-cost claim.
offline_route_trace_result.KaHIP: Must freeze a trained/all-graph assignment once, then emit each route using that same assignment. Repartitioning the selected graph per query would move persistent weights and is invalid.

cost_reproducibility.available: Exact MVM depth/instruction counts, active cores/tiles, static load/store/send/receive lengths, compiler register spills, original heuristic load expression.
cost_reproducibility.movement_unit_caution: printReport labels counters as bytes, but increments use Operation::length() with no explicit dtype multiplier. Preserve reported units or call them vector-element movement counts until a numeric ABI is specified.
cost_reproducibility.units: Compiler common.h does not state the unit or derivation. Separately NVSim constant.h says ns scale, CLOCK_FREQ=1e9 and Result.cpp prints ceil(seconds*CLOCK_FREQ) as ns. This is consistent with 1ns circuit ticks, but does not establish an end-to-end compiler timing engine or validate the compiler constants.
cost_reproducibility.circuit_run_blocker: NVSim requires tech_params/config/parasitic.cfg and other geometry files generated by Calculate.py. The shipped example.cfg leaves required dimensions and temperature as FIXME; they were not guessed.
cost_reproducibility.area_cycles: Cannot reproduce calibrated subarray area/cycles, ADC/ALU/network costs or end-to-end latency with shipped material alone. README says ADC and switched-integrator HSPICE costs are in original paper Table II, which was not obtained.

baseline_audit.row_col_note: For generic ConstantMatrix, row- and column-major branches actually use the same width-then-height loops in this commit. CNN/FC-specific branches differ. For G4 C<8192 there is only one width tile anyway.

KaHIP_bug.observed: assignVTilesWithKaHIP computes consumerNodeID using getVCore(producer), so producerNodeID and consumerNodeID always equal; no tile graph communication edge is added.
KaHIP_bug.consequence: Uncorrected GP_KAHIP is not a strong communication-aware comparison. A separately documented corrected adapter/graph, frozen before route evaluation, is needed. Upstream was not edited.

baseline_audit.KaHIP_dependency: Source invokes external kaffpaE; neither kaffpaE nor kaffpa found on current PATH. No KaHIP run was claimed.
baseline_audit.placer: Identity virtual-to-physical tile assignment with TODO; absence of a public distance/cycle network model prevents converting permutation-only placement into claimed speedup.

G4_one_layer_geometry.scope: One-layer trace study fits original parameter count. Full 40-layer G4 with original one-matrix-tile/core policy does not fit one configured chip. Do not silently use unbounded compiler tiling, assume cross-chip transport, or claim unused-depth compaction already supported.
G4_one_layer_geometry.capacity_enforcement_caveat: N_MAX_TILE is used only in loadBalance(), whose original total_tile_num arithmetic excludes explicit reserved-IO accounting and does not round up. Generic ConstantMatrix compile() has no observed enforcement. The audit treats the original constant as a resource bound rather than trusting compile success to prove fit; either 224-tile interpretation is far below 40-layer 51200-core requirement.

falsifiable_next_experiment.question: Under fixed native matrix tiles, does a fixed MoE layout lower selected-route input distribution plus activation redistribution/output movement versus correct weighted-graph partitioning, while preserving original core/tile capacity?
falsifiable_next_experiment.backend_scope: Offline original-MVM trace and resource counting only; no AiF tR or CR-read used.
falsifiable_next_experiment.mechanism: Use original per-core independent inputs and per-tile fanout domains; place GU output tiles and expert-private down consumers with route-conditioned input multicast counted once per touched tile. No matrix duplication, multi-context extension or sparse opcode.
strong_comparisons: original row and equivalent generic column mapping
reject_if: Correct weighted partitioning/contiguous expert placement already reaches the movement lower bound.
Any alleged gain needs per-query weight remapping, newly shared private inputs, undocumented depth packing, or invented timing.
Only a movement count gain remains and no public timing/energy model can show its practical contribution.
falsifiable_next_experiment.novelty: No publication breakthrough established. Communication-aware mapping and input-affinity are prior art; this artifact supplies a distinct backend and a means to falsify claims, not novelty by itself.

evidence.claim: Original hardware constants and compiler heuristic constants.
Same-x row tiles, depth input chunks, and existing partial-sum ADD.
Full constant-matrix inventory assigned even if a tile has no users.
Per-core load reuse and per-tile receive reuse.
Text instruction generation; TODO binary ABI.
Circuit latency output converts seconds to 1ns ticks.
Original PIM config explicitly says no fabricated PIM unit available.

build_caveats: Observed original compiler warnings include non-void functions missing return and ignored system() return.
Observed original NVSim warnings include sscanf %d used for bool fields pimMode/lpDecoder.
No upstream fixes were applied; successful trace probes do not validate all code paths or numerical execution.
